g.text: BI with Moiz: the public lab opens
Data & Analytics Engineer · Power BI Analyst
About 350 hand-maintained ADF pipelines and 165 per-client source setups,
Metadata-driven pipelines: connections, mappings, parameters and run
controls moved into reusable config files.
33 production pipelines on 4 standard source patterns. A new client is now a
A tenant migration without the manual grind
625 reports had to move to a new enterprise tenant, each one deployed and
A GUI migration and governance app: transfer, workspace mapping, validation
625 reports and access for about 80 workspaces moved, with fewer deployment
Data quality before the report, not after
Bad source files showed up as broken reports and were fixed one file at a time.
Schema validation, source-to-target mapping, duplicate detection and
Fewer report failures and faster fixes on datasets above 600K records.
Finance, sales and operations reporting was scattered, and the executive
Model redesign, aggregation tables, query folding and DAX tuning, on governed
Reports up to 70% faster, with the KPIs in one drillable view for leadership.
From vague requests to numbers people trust
Requests arrived vague, and report issues were patched where they showed up.
Dimensional models, standard KPI definitions, source-to-report reconciliation
Reporting stakeholders relied on, with the business logic written down.
Reports were built on manual source extracts.
Reusable SQL queries and views, then Power BI reports, DAX and stable
The start of eight years in Power BI.
